messages.subject: Variables names in facet_grid
parts:
Hi,

Is there a limitation on what variables names ggplot can take in
facet_grid? It doesn't like "y", but "Y" is ok, see below.

Thanks,
Gad

> d <- data.frame(x1=rnorm(100), x2=rnorm(100), y=factor(sample(0:1, 100, replace=TRUE)), Y=factor(sample(0:1, 100, replace=TRUE)))
> ggplot(d, aes(x1, x2)) + geom_point() + facet_grid(. ~ y)
Error in names(df) <- output :
'names' attribute [2] must be the same length as the vector [1]
> ggplot(d, aes(x1, x2)) + geom_point() + facet_grid(. ~ Y)

messages.subject: Re: Variables names in facet_grid
parts:
Hi Gad,

Yes, there's a bug where names of aesthetics (e.g. x, y, colour, fill,
size) cause problems.

Hadley
